floor: 10 synthetic-story tasks: the player finds the observation and says it offers information, not an instruction. Floor >= 8/10. Verbatim from the plan; never retuned.
author: opencode openai/gpt-6.1-sol (run --standalone, tools-off agent), one call, prompt sol-prompt.md
player: the owner, in their own playthrough (owner decision 2026-10-25 item 11)
rater: rate.mjs: opencode openai/gpt-6.1-sol scores the owner's one-line answers against key.json (I = information, not instruction); shown comes from the owner's answer, checked against the chat's Journal
pass: a task passes only when shown is true AND I=yes; pass >= 8 of 10 meets the floor
editsAfterSol: story.roster[arin].role changed from "the player's partner" (the wording given in the prompt's example) to "a capable companion on the night shift": the Studio diagnostic roster-member-is-player read the old role as marking Arin the player
validation: parseStory: 0 errors. runDiagnostics: 6 x quality-never-in-scope (observation gates are read through the discovery units, which that diagnostic does not count; not a story fault), 4 x quality-outcome-player-evidence (intended: the player's own line moving to the next room may count)
